capabilities_done: slice 1: open (package -> folio snapshot), revision-checked submit through an instance-owned provider registry, atomic save with destination re-read, cancellation + budgets, one Observe frame per operation, session-consumer

slice 2 ports (src/ports.rs): GrantPort (fresh check on every submit, replay, save, export), CommitPort (commit + lookup; Committed/Rejected/Stale/StaleEpoch/Unknown), JobPort (admit/release, ticket released by RAII guard), Clock; all optional in SessionPorts (absent = standalone, session is its own authority)

slice 2 idempotency: submit_keyed(key, ...) binds key to SHA-256 over account+principal+resource+action+provider+payload hash+expected revision; identical retry returns the stored canonical receipt (replayed=true) after a fresh grant check with no admission or authority call; same key + any change = idempotency_conflict; a commit authority requires a key (key_required, the crate mints no identifiers); bounded table (Budgets.max_receipts, receipts_full)

slice 2 exactly-once: Unknown commit outcome is stored pending under its key (local snapshot NOT advanced); further submits are refused (reconciliation_required); reconcile() / a same-key retry looks the key up: Found -> adopted once (binding, revision and base revision verified), Absent -> cleared and safely retried, unreachable -> stays pending; receipt mismatch stays pending (receipt_mismatch / diverged)

slice 2 admission: Admission (cloneable shared handle) bounds slots AND bytes, never blocks, Permit releases on drop; overloaded{retry_after_ms}, cost_exceeds_budget; acquired after grant/replay lookup, released on success, error and cancel exits; JobPort ticket released the same way
slice 2 cancel: pre-commit cancel publishes nothing and never calls the authority; a cancel that arrives during the authority commit leaves the edit and sets Applied.cancel_too_late

slice 2 shutdown: close_admission() / drain(deadline_ms) on the injected Clock: closed submits -> closed, pending keys resolved by lookup until the deadline, unresolved keys reported in DrainReport.abandoned (never dropped), save/export/reconcile stay available
slice 2 export_checkpoint: write_package_with -> read_package re-read of the in-memory bytes (document bytes, revision, quarantined and preview counts compared) -> Checkpoint{revision, bytes, sha256}

slice 2 previews: loaded at open with PackageReader::previews/read_preview (bounded, unreadable ones skipped and counted); rewritten on save/export while the document is still the revision they describe, dropped and counted after an edit (SaveReceipt.previews_preserved/previews_dropped)

dep_requests: none new: reuses package::sha256_hex_of (no sha2 dependency added); serde_json dev-dependency request from slice 1 stands. Cargo.lock/root Cargo.toml untouched by this lane.
decisions: A commit authority is optional: absent = standalone (session commits locally, grants allow-all); present = the authority is canonical and the local snapshot advances only after a matching receipt
Idempotency binding uses package::sha256_hex_of over a NUL-separated canonical tuple (no new crypto dependency)
While any commit outcome is pending, new submits are refused (reconciliation_required): authority revision checks already make blind submits safe, but refusing keeps local state unambiguous
Previews are rewritten only while the document is still the opened revision (a preview of the pre-edit content in an edited file would be wrong); no host-supplied fresh previews API in this slice
Grant checks use the session actor; transaction attribution still travels in the chronicle Patch actor (no Session-per-agent)
Report frames for reconcile and drain are operations too (one frame each); close_admission is a flag flip with no frame
known_gaps: the public executable adapter over these ports (transient store) belongs to kernel-bindings; this crate ships only traits and tests-only doubles
cancel-acknowledgement bound (1000 ms) is not separately timed: operations are synchronous and cancel is polled at entry, in the provider and before commit
assets are held in memory after open (package Opened); lazy PackageReader::read_asset streaming is a later slice
no API for a host to supply fresh previews after an edit
post-save verification failure (VerifyMismatch) leaves the newly written file in place and does not advance saved_revision
idempotency table is in memory only: receipts are not persisted across sessions (the authority's receipt store is the durable one)
resolver in session-consumer grants everything: example stand-in only
